coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player plugin that provides a unified API layer for managing UI components including side panels, upper bar icons, floating elements, toasts, and banners within the Kaltura Player ecosystem.

featureOwnership: Side Panel Management - Controls side panel positioning (top, bottom, left, right), activation/deactivation, expand/collapse modes, and counter-panel logic
Upper Bar Management - Manages upper bar icon ordering, responsive display based on player size, and icon registry
Floating Element Management - Handles floating UI components positioned in VideoArea, InteractiveArea, or PresetArea
Toast Notifications - Manages toast display with configurable severity, duration, and positioning (BottomLeft, etc.)
Banner Display - Controls single banner display with auto-close functionality and theme configuration
Preset Management - Coordinates UI components across different player presets (Playback, Live)
Detachable Panels - Supports detaching side panel content to separate browser windows
dataHandling: UI Component Registry - Maintains registry of added UI components (panels, icons, floating items)
Active Panel State - Tracks currently active side panels per position
Player Preset State - Manages UI across ReservedPresetNames (Playback, Live, Idle, Error)
Side Panel Modes - Handles SidePanelModes (ALONGSIDE, OVER, HIDDEN)
Icon Order Configuration - Stores and applies icon ordering in upper bar
Canvas/Video Size Cache - Caches player and video dimensions for responsive behavior

upstream: @playkit-js/kaltura-player-js - Core player instance and BasePlugin class
@playkit-js/playkit-js-ui - UI framework, redux store, reducers, and preset system
downstream: Kaltura Player Plugins - Any plugin using getService('sidePanelsManager'), getService('upperBarManager'), getService('floatingManager'), getService('toastManager'), or getService('bannerManager')
Plugin UI Components - Custom panel components, icon components, floating content renderers
externalAPIs: Preact - UI rendering framework (h, createRef, Component lifecycle)
preact-render-to-string - Server-side rendering support for detached windows

frameworks: Redux - State management via playkit-js-ui store
entryPoints: src/ui-managers.ts - UIManagers plugin class that registers all services

triageKeywords: icon not showing in upper bar

registeredServices.name: sidePanelsManager
registeredServices.purpose: Add, remove, activate, deactivate, detach/attach side panel items

registeredServices.name: upperBarManager
registeredServices.purpose: Add, remove, update icons in the player upper bar

registeredServices.name: floatingManager
registeredServices.purpose: Add, remove floating UI elements in video/interactive/preset areas

registeredServices.name: toastManager
registeredServices.purpose: Display timed toast notifications with configurable severity and position

registeredServices.name: bannerManager
registeredServices.purpose: Display single banner overlay with optional auto-close
